reports.title: llm: add a provider cooldown registry and honour Retry-After instead of a constant retry backoff
reports.summary: The issue proposes adding a provider cooldown registry and honoring the Retry-After header to improve rate limiting. Currently the retry mechanism uses a constant exponential backoff and ignores the Retry-After values sent by providers, leading to repeated attempts during rate limit windows. This feature will track per‑provider cooldown periods and respect provider‑specified retry delays.
reports.suggested_next_action: Design and implement a provider cooldown registry that stores the time a provider hit a rate limit, and modify the retry loop to use the captured Retry-After value (or the registry) instead of the fixed backoff.
